# Open-Source Paid Maintenance Opportunity Review

## Purpose
Evaluates whether a public open-source project has a legitimate, transparent paid maintenance or support opportunity.

## Workflow
1. Review public project activity, contribution guidance, support channels, sponsorship or commercial-service terms, issue backlog, release cadence, and license metadata.
2. Distinguish official paid programs from speculative demand.
3. Identify maintainers' stated needs and evidence of a service gap.
4. Assess skills required, time cost, conflict-of-interest concerns, and whether outreach is permitted.
5. Present opportunities without contacting anyone.

## Output
Evidence-linked opportunity brief, legitimacy and demand signals, qualification score rationale, effort estimate, and unanswered questions.

## Safety and limits
- Do not scrape private contact data, imply endorsement, create issues, or contact maintainers. No runtime activation or tool grants.
- Research, drafting, and planning only; execution requires a separate future approval and reviewed integration.

## Provenance
CEOAI-authored workflow. Intake candidate only.
